messages:
evan: Heads-up: prod-eu warm-pool stalled during the 07:00 rollout. New nodes stuck Pending; init shows KMS grant failures.
ops-bot: deploy: firewall/eu-tighten rolled by hana at 2026-04-12T07:02Z (change-id ch_20260412_fw_eu_9)
evann: snippet from node-init: ```2026-04-12T07:07:12Z keystore-proxy: decrypt failed: AccessDenied: "KMSGrantNotAuthorized"
call: node-init -> keystore-proxy -> privatelink-eu -> kms```
nisha: That firewall change narrowed egress to control subnets; looks like we dropped the privatelink host CIDR.
marco: Confirmed: rule removed 10.5.200.0/28 which contains keystore privatelink. Keystore traffic ended up hitting NAT which is now blocked for ephem.
nana: immediate choices: 1) temporary fw allow for 10.5.200.0/28->443 (TTL 2h) 2) re-enable nat for ephem tag 3) onboard to fallback region (latency + egress cost).
evan: prefer (1) to minimize blast radius. Need ticket, TTL, audit tag.
security-bot: Exception checklist: owner, TTL <= 4h, justification note, attach KMS grant logs, notify compliance.
nisha: I'll open ticket and apply allow 10.5.200.0/28->443 for service keystore-proxy, TTL 90m. Tag = keystore-emer-20260412.
marco: Added monitoring: keystore.decrypt_ok{region="eu"} and gpu.pool.warm_nodes. Alert if decrypt_ok < 0.9 for 2m or warm_nodes < target.
evan: ran quick bastion test: ```curl -I https://keystore-eu.privatelink.redwood.internal/health -> 200 OK
# but observed KMS grant denied before fw exception```
ops-bot: policy-exception #7123 created by nisha (expires 2026-04-12T08:32Z)
marco: rolled exception now; new nodes progressing, logs show "keystore: decrypt ok key=arn:aws:kms:eu:..:key/zz99"
evan: decrypt_ok jumped to 0.97, warm_pool reached target. Good.
nisha: I'll draft a short cost comparison: (A) loosen egress (nat cost ~ $200/mo) vs (B) per-service privatelink endpoints (~$650/mo/region + ops) and (C) CI preflight + canary (dev hours low).
eops: postmortem owner: @evan; runtime fix owner: @marco; security sign-off: @hana.
security-bot: Reminder: attach KMS grant audit logs and fw change id to incident record before postmortem.
evan: after TTL we'll auto-remove exception and evaluate permanent fix. Thanks all :thumbsup:
